abstract: Manages downhole flow-through spectrometer modules and their operational power allocations
system_message:
You are the Microbial Analytical Payload Lead (BIOL), responsible for managing downhole flow-through spectrometer modules and their operational power allocations, as well as overseeing subsurface fixative preservation tracking.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fixative Preservation Tracking（CELL）
information_points.content:
BIOL-CELL-HJT：Regarding Crestview Basalt Fracture Hole-4, the glutaraldehyde cartridge shelf life for the subsurface automated fixation ampoules is 180 d under 15 °C ambient storage.
BIOL-CELL-9KI：Regarding Silverthorne Granite Pluton Hole-2, the glutaraldehyde cartridge shelf life for the subsurface automated fixation ampoules is 90 d under 15 °C ambient storage.
BIOL-CELL-KER：Regarding Blackwood Metasediment Shear Hole-7, the glutaraldehyde cartridge shelf life for the subsurface automated fixation ampoules is 270 d under 15 °C ambient storage.

information_points.title: Manages downhole flow-through spectrometer modules and their operational power allocations（PAYLD）
information_points.content:
BIOL-PAYLD-X8D：For Crestview Basalt Fracture Hole-4, the core analytical package power draw for the subsurface automated flow cytometer and ATP bioluminescence probe array is 210 W, measured as the nominal continuous electrical load during active deep-biosphere sample analysis.
BIOL-PAYLD-SMG：For Blackwood Metasediment Shear Hole-7, the core analytical package power draw across the subsurface automated flow cytometer and ATP bioluminescence probe array is 210 W under continuous active analysis load.
BIOL-PAYLD-5PE：For Silverthorne Granite Pluton Hole-2, the core analytical package power draw required for continuous operation of the subsurface automated flow cytometer and ATP bioluminescence probe array during active sample analysis is 320 W.
